title: વોટ્સએપની રીત
caption: દુકાન બંધ કરતી વખતે રવિ થાકી જાય છે. તે વોટ્સએપ પર ત્રણ આંકડા મોકલે છે, અને તેનો હિસાબ લખાઈ જાય છે.
linkedin_text: A shopkeeper at closing time does not want another form. He sends three numbers in one WhatsApp message: sales, expenses and cash. ScoreMyBiz records them. In the free month a photo of the notebook or a voice note works too, and nothing is saved until he says YES.

cast.ravi: Ravi, a young Indian mobile-phone shop owner with a trimmed beard in a checked shirt and a lanyard

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a navy suit and striped tie, facing the camera in a busy market lane at night, shop signs glowing behind him, a warm smile.
